svg.title: Lumen reflections: resolved hit distance
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. Lumen reflections: resolved hit distance graph 0001 | ReflectionsResolve pass | FLOAT_32_MAX -> half inf = no hit hit distance (log10, near=blue -> far=red) no valid hit (inf / >=60000) zero distance LumenReflectionResolve.usf:650 writes Center.MinRayHitT; InitReflectionLighting sets FLOAT_32_MAX for no hit. In the PF_R16F destination that becomes +inf (or a value at the half maximum); it is displayed as a categorical miss, not distance 0. The figure is the exact 1280x720 view rect of the ResolvedSpecularIndirectDepth array slice 0.
